description.en:
Sets one participant of the next skill scene, in the skill settings table (side, then INFO entry number index).
The table is marked as a skill setup (EV_TYPE "SKILL"); if it was already set up for another kind of scene, nothing is written and null is returned.
Full form (10 arguments, used by SetChrPrmDetailForSkillScript): mode 1 gives the character para_cpNNNN (NNNN = number) with its kit: CHARA, UNIFORM_NO, HOME, KEEPER, SHOES, GLOVE and NUMBER. The shirt number is written as 0 when the uniform is 900 or more. Any other mode writes an empty entry (character 0).
Two-argument form (side, parameter ID string): it creates a character object for participant 1 right away (named wchr攻撃1 for "ATK", wchr防御1 otherwise) and stores its handle as PREHANDLE, with a figure value from that character's data as PREFIGURE. No shipped script uses this form.
Side of the skill scene: "ATK" (attacking side) or "DEF" (defending side).
Participant number on that side, starting at 1. In the two-argument form, a parameter ID string instead.
Uniform (kit) number; 900 and above are special outfits.
Shirt number (ignored when uniform is 900 or more).
Always null, whether the entry was written or not (null if the script system is not ready, fewer than 2 arguments, the table set up for another scene kind, or the entry could not be created).

examples.case: Two-argument form (not found in script_clean/; invented)
examples.code:
// Create the attacking participant from its parameter ID at once
CMND_SETUP_SKL_SQ_CHARA("ATK", "para_cp0008");
